directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Electric 40 Concrete Pump power text in Xingtai as: Motor Power is 45 kW. An electric motor entry is kilowatts on a motor. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dynamometer.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动40型混凝土泵的动力文字写成：电机功率是45 kW。画面「Tractor」的主体是XTZ 243K。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dynamometer。

heading.en: Principles of operation of torque power (absorbing) dynamometers
heading.zh: 吸收式测功机的工作原理

body.en: Picture source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dynamometer. Subject: Dyno. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Electric 40 Concrete Pump power text in Xingtai as: Motor Power is 45 kW. The frame “Tractor” shows XTZ 243K. Electric drive and diesel drive are different supplies. Max. Outlet Pressure remains 23 MPa. Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³. Those entries, when shown, stay in their own columns.
body.zh: 图片来源：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dynamometer。画面主体：Dyno。河北品锦机械在邢台把电动40型混凝土泵的动力文字写成：电机功率是45 kW。河北品锦机械不从这一帧里提取千瓦或发动机代号。

body.en: An electric motor entry is kilowatts on a motor. It does not change this power entry, and a diesel code is not copied onto an electric row. Use the label on this sheet, not the neighbouring model's label. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not lift kilowatts or an engine code out of that frame. Fine Stone Pumping (H / V) 120 m / 360 m. A larger motor entry is not a longer pipeline.
body.zh: 画面「Tractor」的主体是XTZ 243K。细石输送（水平/垂直） 120 m / 360 m。

body.en: A diesel entry names the engine line that is actually shown. Motor Power is 45 kW. Output Capacity remains 21 m³/h. If this row has no voltage entry, none is invented. Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki 112.
body.zh: 它不改这一格动力，也不会把柴油机代号抄到电动行上。

question.en: What power text does Electric 40 Concrete Pump list?
question.zh: 电动40型混凝土泵的动力文字是什么？

answer.en: Motor Power is 45 kW. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dynamometer.
answer.zh: 电机功率是45 kW。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dynamometer画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Can a diesel code be moved onto this row?
question.zh: 可以把柴油机代号挪到这一行吗？

answer.en: Only if this row already lists it. Otherwise the entry stays as written. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dynamometer.
answer.zh: 只有这一行已经标出了才能算。否则格子保持原样。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dynamometer画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: What are output and pressure on this sheet?
question.zh: 这一页的输送量和压力是多少？

answer.en: Output Capacity is 21 m³/h. Max. Outlet Pressure is 23 MPa. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dynamometer.
answer.zh: 理论输送量是21 m³/h。最大出口压力是23 MPa。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dynamometer画面里印出的数字。
